articles.summary: AlloSure® Kidney trajectories within the first four months post-transplant were associated with three-year graft outcomes CareDx, Inc. (Nasdaq: CDNA) — a leading precision medicine diagnostics company in transplant, specialty oncology, and cell therapy, today announced the publication of a new analysis from the Kidney Allograft Outcomes AlloSure Registry (KOAR), a landmark multicenter study, in the journal Transplantation . The third manuscript from KOAR investigated the correlation between early post-transplant AlloSure Kidney donor-derived cell-free DNA (dd-cfDNA) levels and three-year kidney allograft outcomes in a multicenter cohort of 1,137 kidney transplant recipients across 56 centers. Recipients were categorized into trajectory groups based on AlloSure Kidney measurements obtained within the first four months post-transplant: consistently low, transient-elevation, late-elevation, and persistent-elevation.
